1.plot: 该剧以职业冰球联赛为背景，改编自Rachel Reid的同名小说，讲述了肖恩·霍兰德与伊利亚·罗扎诺夫长达八年的复杂关系；两人自17岁相识后，在赛场屡次交锋对抗，私下却因隐秘情愫陷入纠结，最终不得不在竞技荣耀与禁忌情感间作出抉择的故事。
1.plotEn: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.

2.plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
2.plotEn: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
2.playbill: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
2.playbillEn: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

3.plot: 新英格兰小岛寡妇湾长期流传着关于诅咒的传说。市长汤姆·洛夫蒂斯试图将小岛打造为旅游胜地，却在游客涌入后接连遭遇一系列诡异事件。随着事态不断失控，笼罩小岛的神秘传说逐渐成为现实。
3.plotEn: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

6.plot: 马特是一位新上任的电影制片公司负责人，为了获得各路名流的认可，他和大陆影业的执行团队必须在公司利益和创意追求之间寻求平衡，同时还要力图为电影制作注入新的生机和活力，并与时俱进。
6.plotEn: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

7.plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
7.plotEn: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
7.playbill: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
7.playbillEn: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

9.plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
9.plotEn: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
9.playbill: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
9.playbillEn: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

10.plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
10.plotEn: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
10.playbill: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
10.playbillEn: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

12.plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
12.plotEn: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
12.playbill: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
12.playbillEn: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

13.plot: 一群敬业、热情的老师和一位略显失聪的校长聚集在费城的一所公立学校，决心帮助学生在生活中取得成功。
13.plotEn: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don’t love the school district’s less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

16.plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
16.plotEn: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
16.playbill: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
16.playbillEn: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.

17.plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
17.plotEn: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
17.playbill: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
17.playbillEn: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

19.plot: 它不是漫画的逐格重拍。故事从 1921 年塔尔萨的种族屠杀开场，再落到一个蒙面警察仍在执勤的美国，雷吉娜·金饰演的安吉拉要查清父辈留下的身份。
19.plotEn: It is not a panel-by-panel remake of the comic. The story opens with the 1921 massacre in Tulsa and then settles in an America where masked police are still on duty. Angela, played by Regina King, has to find out the identity her father’s generation left her.
19.playbill: 不是电影版的翻拍，而是原著漫画的续集，故事放在 2019 年。它把超级英雄故事和美国的种族暴力史连在一起，开场就是 1921 年的塔尔萨种族屠杀。不看原著也能看，看过会更有收获。共获 11 项艾美奖。
19.playbillEn: It is not a remake of the film. It is a sequel to the original comic, set in 2019. It joins a superhero story to the history of racial violence in the United States. It opens with the 1921 Tulsa massacre. You can watch it without the comic. If you have read it, there is more. It won 11 Emmys.

21.plot: 罗斯一家把财产输光，只好搬进他们曾经当作玩笑买下的小镇。汽车旅馆的两个房间里，原来的做派一点一点碰上来自小镇的善意。
21.plotEn: The Rose family loses its fortune and has to move to the small town they once bought as a joke. In two rooms at the motel, the old manner collides, a little at a time, with the town’s goodwill.
21.playbill: 富豪一家破产，只能搬进他们当玩笑买下的小镇。第一季看着像普通的富人落难喜剧，后面越来越温暖，每个人都有成长。最后一季包揽了艾美喜剧类全部七个主要奖项。
21.playbillEn: A rich family goes broke and has to move to a town they bought as a joke. The first season looks like an ordinary comedy about the rich brought low. Later it gets warmer, and each person changes. The last season swept all seven major comedy Emmys.

22.plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
22.plotEn: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
22.playbill: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
22.playbillEn: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

23.plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
23.plotEn: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
23.playbill: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
23.playbillEn: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

25.plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
25.plotEn: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
25.playbill: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
25.playbillEn: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

27.plot: 埃莉诺死后醒来，发现自己进了一套按积分分配的来世，而档案显然搞错了人。邻居、道德哲学课和一位礼貌的建筑师，一起维持这个漂亮的社区。
27.plotEn: Eleanor wakes up dead and finds she has entered an afterlife assigned by points, and the file has clearly got the wrong person. The neighbors, a class in moral philosophy, and a polite architect keep this handsome neighborhood going.
27.playbill: 女主死后被误送进「善地」，只好偷偷学做好人，以免被发现。它把伦理学和哲学问题讲得轻松好懂。第一季结尾有个大反转，最好别被剧透。
27.playbillEn: The heroine dies and is sent by mistake to the Good Place, so she secretly learns how to be good before anyone notices. It explains ethics and philosophy lightly enough to follow. The end of the first season has a large reversal. Better not to have it spoiled.

28.plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
28.plotEn: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
28.playbill: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
28.playbillEn: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

30.plot: 厄恩辍学回到亚特兰大，替表兄、说唱歌手纸男孩管理刚起步的事业。城市、种族和名气在这里都不按常理出牌，有的集干脆走进另一个类型。
30.plotEn: Earn drops out and comes back to Atlanta to manage the early career of his cousin, the rapper Paper Boi. The city, race, and fame do not behave as expected here, and some episodes simply walk into another genre.
30.playbill: 表面讲穷小子给当说唱歌手的表弟做经纪人，实际每一集风格都可能不同：有时是荒诞喜剧，有时像恐怖片。它写美国黑人生活很独特，不说教，却处处刺人。第二季的《泰迪·珀金斯》一集尤其出名。
30.playbillEn: On the surface, a broke young man manages his cousin, a rapper. In practice each episode can be a different kind of show: sometimes an absurd comedy, sometimes something like a horror film. It writes Black life in America in its own way, without lectures, and it keeps pricking. The second-season episode “Teddy Perkins” is the one people single out.

31.plot: 聚焦美国史上著名的犯罪故事，每季单独为一个完整的事件。
31.plotEn: An anthology series centered around some of history's most famous criminal investigations.

33.plot: 主人公是一个中上阶层的黑人（Anthony Anderson），他试图依靠自己保留的「文化特性」来抚育子女，但却在各方面遭遇障碍：开明大方的妻子（Tracee Ellis Ross），因循守旧的父亲，还有被时代「同化」的孩子们全都反对他。
33.plotEn: A family man struggles to gain a sense of cultural identity while raising his kids in a predominantly white, upper-middle-class neighborhood.

34.plot: 心碎永远改变了年轻而谦虚的何塞·阿尔弗雷多的命运。多年后，他成为了阿尔弗雷多勋爵，一个珠宝帝国的成功所有者和一个痴迷于权力的人。脾气暴躁、狡猾的他试图平衡动荡的婚姻、婚外恋以及子女之间关于事业继承权的纠纷。然而有一天，一个他不知道的女儿的意外出现，给他的生活带来了剧变，并将他的家庭冲突推向了一个全新的高度。
34.plotEn: Heartbreak forever changed the fate of the young and humble José Alfredo. Years later, he became the Lord Alfredo, a successful owner of a jewelry empire and a man obsessed with power. Temperamental and cunning, he tries to balance his turbulent marriage, an extramarital love affair, and the dispute between his children over succession in his business. One day, however, the unexpected appearance of a possible daughter, of whom he was unaware, causes upheaval in his life and takes his familial conflicts to a whole new level.

36.plot:
《艾米·舒默的内心》是一部由艾米·舒默创作并主持的美国喜剧喜剧电视连续剧。该剧于 2013 年 4 月 30 日至 2016 年 6 月 16 日在 Comedy Central 播出，并于 2022 年在 Paramount+ 重播第五季。舒默和丹尼尔·鲍威尔担任该剧的执行制片人。该剧获得了皮博迪奖，并获得了八项黄金时段艾美奖提名，并赢得了三项。
《艾米·舒默内心》第二季于 2014 年 6 月 3 日完结，一周后续订第三季。第三季于2015年4月21日首播，并于同日订购第四季，并于一年后的2016年4月21日首播。2016年1月6日，该剧续订第五季。 2016年8月，尽管早些时候宣布续订，但仍有人猜测该剧已被取消。舒默通过社交媒体否认了这些报道，称该剧的制作正在中断，而她则专注于巡演。不过，她也表示自己“不再出演这个节目”。据《纽约时报》2019 年 3 月的采访称，舒默签订了制作该剧另一季的合同，这导致该剧最终回归。

36.plotEn:
Inside Amy Schumer is an American sketch comedy television series created and hosted by Amy Schumer. The series aired on Comedy Central from April 30, 2013, to June 16, 2016, and was revived in 2022 for a fifth season on Paramount+. Schumer and Daniel Powell served as the show's executive producers. The show received a Peabody Award and has been nominated for eight Primetime Emmy Awards, winning three.
Inside Amy Schumer completed its second season on June 3, 2014, and was renewed for a third season a week later. The third season premiered on April 21, 2015, with a fourth season ordered the same day, which premiered one year later on April 21, 2016. On January 6, 2016, the show was renewed for a fifth season. In August 2016, there was speculation though that the show had been cancelled despite the earlier announcement of renewal. Schumer denied the reports via social media, stating that production of the show was going on hiatus while she focused on touring. However, she also stated that she was "not making the show anymore". According to a March 2019 interview by The New York Times, Schumer was under contract to produce another season of the show, leading to its eventual return.
On February 24, 2021, it was announced that the show would be revived with five specials by Paramount+. On September 20, 2022, it was reported that the five installments were no longer called specials but instead would be the five episodes of the fifth season: two episodes debuting on October 20, with the rest released weekly. The series was canceled on June 26, 2023, and removed from Paramount+, while plans to air the fifth season were subsequently dropped on Comedy Central. The complete series library was acquired by Hulu.

37.plot: 高中化学老师沃尔特·怀特确诊肺癌，为了给家人留下钱，与前学生杰西合伙制造冰毒。一条房车里的生计，慢慢变成一座他不肯交出的帝国。
37.plotEn: Walter White, a high-school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with lung cancer. To leave money for his family he partners with his former student Jesse and starts making meth. A living made in a trailer slowly becomes an empire he will not hand over.
37.playbill: 看一个普通人怎样一步步变成毒枭，每次转变都有前因，不是突然黑化。克兰斯顿凭这个角色拿了四座艾美剧情类男主角。前两季稍慢，越往后越紧；第五季的《奥兹曼迪亚斯》常被评为美剧史上最好的单集之一。
37.playbillEn: You watch an ordinary man become a drug lord, and each turn has a cause. He does not simply go bad. Cranston won four Emmys for best actor in a drama for the role. The first two seasons are a little slow, and it tightens after that. “Ozymandias,” in the fifth season, is often called one of the best single episodes in American television.

38.plot: 检察官彼得·弗洛里克因性丑闻和贪腐下台，妻子艾丽西娅十三年后回到律师事务所。案件每周进来，公司政治和她自己的名字则慢慢变得更重要。
38.plotEn: The prosecutor Peter Florrick falls over a sex scandal and corruption. Thirteen years later his wife Alicia returns to a law firm. A case comes in every week. The politics of the firm, and her own name, slowly become more important.
38.playbill: 丈夫因丑闻入狱后，艾丽西娅重返律所当律师。每集一个案子，但律所政治、竞选和婚姻线才是长期看点。在法律剧里，它少见地关注科技、政治和媒体。
38.playbillEn: After her husband goes to prison over a scandal, Alicia goes back to a firm as a lawyer. There is a case each episode, but the long-term interest is the politics of the firm, the campaigns, and the marriage. Among legal shows, it is unusual in paying attention to technology, politics, and the media.

39.plot: 脱口秀演员路易在纽约带两个女儿，每一集像一段单独的短片：一场失败的约会、一次上台，或一件突然变得可怕的小事。
39.plotEn: The stand-up comic Louie is raising two daughters in New York. Each episode is like a short film on its own: a failed date, a set, or a small thing that suddenly becomes frightening.
39.playbill: 路易·C·K 自编自导自演，每集像一部短片：有时搞笑，有时伤感，有时很荒诞，影响了后来很多作者型喜剧。主创后来因性骚扰丑闻停工，有观众会因此不看。
39.playbillEn: Louis C.K. writes, directs, and stars. Each episode is like a short: sometimes funny, sometimes sad, sometimes absurd. It influenced a lot of later author-driven comedy. He later stopped working after sexual-harassment allegations, and some viewers will not watch it for that reason.

40.plot: 塞琳娜·迈耶是美国副总统，日程全是没人想要的访问和随时会塌的联盟。她想当总统，幕僚想活命，每一集的危机都来自上一句随口的话。
40.plotEn: Selina Meyer is the vice president of the United States. The schedule is full of visits no one wants and alliances that can collapse at any moment. She wants to be president. The staff want to survive. Each episode’s crisis comes from the previous offhand sentence.
40.playbill: 美国副总统和她的幕僚永远在救火，政治在这里只剩甩锅、抢镜头和骂人。脏话写得极有创意，节奏快到要暂停回看。朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯凭此连拿六座艾美喜剧类女主角。
40.playbillEn: The vice president and her staff are always putting out fires. Politics here is only passing the blame, grabbing the camera, and swearing. The obscenities are extremely inventive, and the pace is fast enough that you will pause and go back. Julia Louis-Dreyfus won six Emmys for lead actress in a comedy for it.

42.plot: 维斯特洛的几个家族争夺铁王座，北境的长城外面还有一场被大多数人当成传说的冬天。改编自乔治·R·R·马丁的小说，贵族的联姻和战场用的是同一套规则。
42.plotEn: Several houses in Westeros contest the Iron Throne. Beyond the Wall in the north, a winter that most people treat as legend is also coming. Adapted from the novels of George R. R. Martin, the nobles’ marriages and the battles run on the same set of rules.
42.playbill: 奇幻外壳下是一部权谋剧。主角随时可能死掉，谁都不安全，这是前几季最抓人的地方。制作规模接近电影，《黑水之战》《私生子之战》都是剧集战争场面的标杆。最后一季口碑大跌，前六季仍然值得看。
42.playbillEn: Under the fantasy is a show about power. Lead characters can die at any time, and no one is safe. That is what made the early seasons grip. The scale of the production is close to a film. “Blackwater” and “The Battle of the Bastards” set a standard for war on television. The last season’s reputation collapsed. The first six are still worth watching.

43.plot: 莱斯利·诺普在印第安纳州波尼镇的公园部门工作，相信会议、表格和一份更厚的早餐能改善公共生活。同事们大多不信，但还是跟着她做。
43.plotEn: Leslie Knope works for the parks department in Pawnee, Indiana, and believes that meetings, forms, and a larger breakfast can improve public life. Her colleagues mostly do not believe it, and follow her anyway.
43.playbill: 小镇公园部门的莱斯莉真心想为社区做点事，身边的同事一个比一个奇葩。第一季比较像《办公室》的翻版，从第二季开始变得温暖又好笑。尼克·奥弗曼演的罗恩·斯旺森是经典角色。
43.playbillEn: Leslie, in a small-town parks department, genuinely wants to do something for the community. The colleagues around her are each stranger than the last. The first season is fairly close to a copy of The Office. From the second season it becomes warm and funny. Nick Offerman’s Ron Swanson is a classic role.

44.plot: 物理学家莱纳德和谢尔顿与同事霍华德、拉杰一起生活、工作。邻居佩妮的出现，让这群天才科学家原本封闭的生活逐渐发生改变。
44.plotEn: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

48.plot: 得州迪隆镇用周五的高中橄榄球衡量几乎一切。教练埃里克·泰勒和妻子塔米要在胜负、孩子的前途和自己的婚姻之间做每周的决定。
48.plotEn: The town of Dillon, Texas, measures almost everything by Friday-night high-school football. The coach Eric Taylor and his wife Tami make the week’s decisions between winning, the children’s futures, and their own marriage.
48.playbill: 背景是得州小镇的高中橄榄球队，但不懂橄榄球也完全能看，重点是小镇里的人。教练和妻子的婚姻常被称为美剧里最真实的夫妻关系之一。大量手持摄影和即兴表演，让人物显得格外自然。
48.playbillEn: The setting is a high-school football team in a Texas town, and you can watch it without knowing the sport. The point is the people in the town. The coach’s marriage is often called one of the most believable marriages on American television. A lot of handheld camera and improvisation makes the people feel unusually natural.

49.plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
49.plotEn: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
49.playbill: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
49.playbillEn: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

50.plot: 普里切特一家三支，以假纪录片的方式过同一座城市里的日子：再婚、同志伴侣和传统郊区家庭，麻烦都出在晚饭之前。
50.plotEn: Three branches of the Pritchett family get through their days in the same city, shot as a fake documentary: a second marriage, a same-sex couple, and a conventional suburban family. The trouble all arrives before dinner.
50.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍三个有亲戚关系的家庭：老夫少妻、同性伴侣和普通的三口之家。每集半小时，笑点稳定，很适合全家一起看。连续五年拿下艾美最佳喜剧剧集。
50.playbillEn: A mockumentary of three related households: an older man with a younger wife, a same-sex couple, and an ordinary family of three. Half an hour an episode, the jokes are steady, and it is easy to watch together. It won the Emmy for best comedy five years in a row.

51.plot: 西雅图格雷斯医院迎来新一批实习生，梅雷迪斯·格雷、克里斯蒂娜·杨、伊泽贝尔·斯蒂文、乔治·梅利 、亚里克斯·卡莱，五个医学院好友同期毕业，需要以良好表现争夺住院医师正式席位。进入医院伊始，梅雷迪斯崩溃地发现前晚在酒吧和她发生一夜情的男人，竟然是神经外科医生德立克·舍伯，两人纠葛就此开始；克里斯蒂娜吸引了胸外科医师普雷斯顿·伯克的注意，因为他们同样高傲和野心勃勃；乔治悄悄爱着梅雷迪斯；美丽的伊泽贝尔第一时间掀起流言，一年的实习期注定充满高密度的压力竞争与荷尔蒙……
51.plotEn: Follows the personal and professional lives of a group of doctors at Seattle's Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital.

53.plot: 一架客机坠毁在热带岛屿，幸存者很快发现这里不是普通的荒岛。每一集用倒叙打开一个人的过去，岛上的谜则越开越多。
53.plotEn: A passenger plane crashes on a tropical island, and the survivors soon find it is not an ordinary deserted island. Each episode opens someone’s past in flashback. The mysteries on the island keep multiplying.
53.playbill: 飞机坠毁在神秘海岛，幸存者遇到越来越多怪事。每集穿插一个人的过去，人物塑造很扎实，也带起了悬疑美剧层层埋坑的风潮。前几季极其上头，结局争议很大。
53.playbillEn: A plane crashes on a mysterious island, and the survivors meet stranger and stranger things. Each episode cuts in someone’s past. The people are solidly built, and the show started the fashion for mystery series that keep burying clues. The early seasons are extremely addictive. The ending was heavily argued over.

55.plot: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，残余的舰队在指挥官阿达玛和总统罗斯林带领下寻找传说中的地球。敌人长得和人一样，也可以爱、可以信仰。
55.plotEn: The Cylon robots nearly wipe out humanity. What is left of the fleet, under Commander Adama and President Roslin, searches for a legendary Earth. The enemy looks human, and can love, and can believe.
55.playbill: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，幸存者跟着一艘战舰逃亡。表面是太空科幻，实际讨论战争、宗教、民主和恐怖主义，很多情节明显影射 9·11 之后的美国。前两季最强。
55.playbillEn: The Cylons nearly destroy humanity, and the survivors flee with a warship. It looks like space science fiction and is really about war, religion, democracy, and terrorism. A lot of it clearly shadows the United States after September 11. The first two seasons are the strongest.

60.plot: 利兹·莱蒙负责一档周六晚间喜剧，上司杰克·多纳吉把管理和约会都当成并购。演员、编剧和电视网每周都在把节目从崩溃里拽回来。
60.plotEn: Liz Lemon runs a Saturday-night comedy show. Her boss, Jack Donaghy, treats management and dating as acquisitions. Every week the actors, the writers, and the network drag the show back from collapse.
60.playbill: 蒂娜·菲根据自己当《周六夜现场》首席编剧的经历改编，讲一档喜剧节目的幕后乱象。笑话密度极高，背景里也塞满了梗。亚历克·鲍德温演的电视台高管杰克是全剧最大的亮点。
60.playbillEn: Tina Fey based it on her years as head writer of Saturday Night Live, and it is about the chaos behind a comedy show. The jokes are packed tight, and the background is full of them too. Alec Baldwin’s network executive, Jack, is the best thing in it.

61.plot: 新世纪之初，充满不祥气息的日蚀渐次逼近，为光怪陆离、纸醉金迷的现代化社会蒙上毁灭的阴影。许是命运的安排，在七十亿人汇聚而成的茫茫人海之中，有那么几个人被赋予了特殊的能力和使命。年轻的人类进化学教授莫汗德（Sendhil Ramamurthy 饰）、高中啦啦队长克莱尔（Hayden Panettiere 饰）、沉湎药品的天才漫画家伊萨克（Santiago Cabrera 饰）、从事临终关怀的男护士皮特（Milo Ventimiglia 饰）、平凡无奇的日本职员中村广（Milo Ventimiglia 饰）、靠脱衣舞供儿子读书的单身妈妈妮基（Ali Larter 饰）等，普通的外表下，却各自拥有着独一无二的超能力。他们为自身的独特而新奇、困扰，又注定肩负着前所未有的重大使命。超能力英雄，接二连三的挑战，迎头而上……
61.plotEn: Common people discover that they have super powers. Their lives intertwine as a devastating event must be prevented.

62.plot: 本剧呈现黑手党生活、美国家庭、意裔美国人社群、暴力支配的世界与道德的灰色地带。由詹姆士·甘多费尼（James Gandolfini）、萝兰·布雷柯（Lorraine Bracco）、艾迪·法柯（Edie Falco）及麦克·英普雷欧里（Michael Imperioli）领衔主演。剧情的主线围绕在东尼·沙普蓝诺（甘多费尼饰）的家庭与自己所领导的犯罪组织的各式矛盾与冲突。
62.plotEn: The story of New Jersey-based Italian-American mobster Tony Soprano and the difficulties he faces as he tries to balance the conflicting requirements of his home life and the criminal organization he heads. Those difficulties are often highlighted through his ongoing professional relationship with psychiatrist Jennifer Melfi. The show features Tony's family members and Mafia associates in prominent roles and story arcs, most notably his wife Carmela and his cousin and protégé Christopher Moltisanti.

63.plot: 宾夕法尼亚一家纸业公司的斯克兰顿分公司，经理迈克尔·斯科特把办公室当成自己的舞台。假纪录片拍下销售、恋爱，以及谁都不想参加的派对。
63.plotEn: At the Scranton branch of a paper company in Pennsylvania, the manager Michael Scott treats the office as his stage. A fake documentary records the sales, the romances, and the parties no one wants to attend.
63.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍一家纸业公司的日常，老板迈克尔每次想当好人都会搞砸。吉姆和帕姆的感情线是很多人坚持看下去的原因。第一季还在模仿英版，从第二季开始找到自己的风格，前七季最好。
63.playbillEn: A mockumentary of daily life at a paper company. Every time the boss, Michael, tries to be a good person, he wrecks it. Jim and Pam’s relationship is the reason a lot of people stay. The first season is still imitating the British original. From the second season it finds its own style. The first seven seasons are the best.

67.plot: 格里高利·豪斯是诊断科的负责人，专接别的医生放弃的病例。他确信病人在撒谎，自己则靠止疼药维持一条受伤的腿和更重的脾气。
67.plotEn: Gregory House runs a department of diagnostics and takes the cases other doctors have given up. He is sure the patient is lying. He himself stays upright on painkillers, for an injured leg and a worse temper.
67.playbill: 天才医生豪斯脾气古怪、嘴毒、对止痛药上瘾，专门诊断别人解决不了的病例，每集都像一个医学版侦探故事。休·劳瑞是英国人，却把美式口音演得毫无破绽。
67.playbillEn: House is a brilliant doctor, rude, mean, and addicted to painkillers. He diagnoses the cases no one else can solve, and each episode is a detective story in a hospital. Hugh Laurie is British, and the American accent has no cracks in it.

69.plot: 地产商乔治·布卢斯被捕后，儿子迈克尔试图拉住这个不断内斗的家族。旁白补上他们不肯承认的那半句，笑话常常要到后面几集才收回来。
69.plotEn: After the developer George Bluth is arrested, his son Michael tries to hold together a family that keeps turning on itself. The narrator supplies the half of the sentence they will not admit, and the jokes are often paid off several episodes later.
69.playbill: 富豪老爸被捕后，只有二儿子迈克尔想撑住这个家，其他人都在添乱。这是最需要专心看的喜剧之一，伏笔和梗会隔好几集甚至好几季才回收。前三季是经典；Netflix 复活的第四、五季口碑差一些。
69.playbillEn: After the rich father is arrested, only the second son, Michael, tries to keep the family standing. Everyone else makes it worse. It is one of the comedies you have to watch closely: setups come back episodes, or seasons, later. The first three seasons are the classic run. The fourth and fifth, revived by Netflix, were received less well.

70.plot: 故事发生於20世纪80年代中期的纽约，《千禧年降临》的第一幕介绍了中心人物路易·爱恩森（Louis Ironson）。他是一名犹太人，与同性恋爱人普莱尔·沃尔特（Prior Walter）住在一起。但普莱尔後来发现自己患有艾滋病，社会在当时对此病仍然知之甚少，路易无法承受住巨大的压力便抛弃了对方搬了出去。与此同时，在城市中另一方，也有一位名为乔·皮特（Joe Pitt）的共和党律师。他是一位摩门教徒，同时也在尽力压制自己的同性恋倾向。剧中，臭名昭著的麦卡锡主义者罗依·康（Roy Cohn）为他提供了一份十分有前途的工作，而乔并没有立刻接受，因为他担心自己服用安定上瘾的妻子哈珀（Harper）。  　　随着剧情发展，普莱尔发现经常有鬼魂和天使来拜访他，还被这些人称为先知；乔在自己的宗教信仰和性取向的矛盾中痛苦挣扎；路易十分後悔抛弃了爱人，时刻受到良心的折磨；乔的妈妈汉娜（Hannah）得知儿子是同性恋後搬到纽约，要照顾儿媳；而罗依·康本人也是一位同志，因为艾滋病住进了医院，负责护理他的护士是一位名为伯利兹（Belize）的黑人同志，他是普莱尔的好友，原来从事过女装表演；最后，原来冷战时期因为罗依·康的幕後操纵而被美国司法处以极刑的共产党人艾瑟尔·罗森堡（Ethel Rosenberg）也化为鬼魂来報復他。  　　全剧充满了黑色幽默与悲剧色彩，对白极为出色，在一些需要特殊效果衬托的地方展现出很浓的戏剧风格。大多数演员都一人分饰几角，比如扮演普莱尔的护士的演员，也同时扮演美国天使。剧中对圣经和美国政治、经济、文化、种族、环境现象有非常多的引用，也有发生在南极和天堂的戏份，也涉及了旧金山的大地震与纽约中央公园中的毕士大（Bethesda）天使像。  　　很多观众与评论家都认为此剧是美国近年来最有影响力的戏剧之一。
70.plotEn: God has abandoned Heaven. It's 1985: the Reagans are in the White House and Death swings the scythe of AIDS. In Manhattan, Prior Walter tells Louis, his lover of four years, he's ill; Louis leaves but as disease and loneliness ravage Prior, guilt invades Louis. Joe Pitt, a Mormon Republican attorney, is pushed by right-wing fixer Roy Cohn toward a job at the Justice Department. Pitt and Cohn are closeted: Pitt, out of shame and religious turmoil; Cohn, to preserve his power and access. Pitt's wife Harper is strung out on Valium, aching to escape a sexless marriage. An angel invites Prior to be a prophet in death.

73.plot: 每年，来自全国各地充满希望的歌手都会参加美国电视历史上最大的节目之一的试镜。谁将成为新的美国偶像？
73.plotEn: Each year, hopeful singers from all over the country audition to be part of one of the biggest shows in American television history. Who will become the new American Idol?

74.plot: 该剧每集讲述一宗刑事案件的调查过程，从不同视角展开，包括警察与侦探、律师、急救人员、记者、受害者、目击者以及犯罪嫌疑人。
74.plotEn: Each episode of this series, set in contemporary Los Angeles, examines one crime from many different viewpoints - uniformed cops, detectives, witnesses, the media, the fire department and rescue squad, even the criminals themselves.

75.plot: “世界上最假新闻团队”针砭时弊，探讨新闻、政治和流行文化领域中的重大事件。
75.plotEn: The World's Fakest News Team tackle the biggest stories in news, politics and pop culture.

76.plot: 深夜12点，美国洛杉矶反恐小组负责人杰克·鲍尔（基弗·萨瑟兰 Kiefer Sutherland 饰）接到同事妮娜·麦尔斯（莎拉·克拉克 Sarah Clarke 饰）的电话，让他火速回办公室，因为情报显示。首位黑人总统候选人——参议员大卫·派尔默（丹尼斯·海斯伯特 Dennis Haysbert 饰）正受到暗杀威胁，而且CTU里面可能有内鬼。因此杰克需要在接下来的这24小时内，追踪杀手保护总统候选人，并查出内鬼。同时，杰克的女儿金姆（伊丽莎·库斯伯特 Elisha Cuthbert 饰）偷跑出家与女友珍妮去参加派对，却不想被挟持。为了找到女儿，特瑞（伊丽莎·库斯伯特 Elisha Cuthbert 饰）和珍妮的父亲只得独自去寻找女儿。可是，不想女儿被绑架原来是恐怖分子策划的，寻找女儿的妻子特瑞也一同被恐怖分子所绑架。为了拯救妻女的性命，杰克不得不听从首领格恩斯（迈克尔·马西 Michael Massee 饰）的摆布。在接下来的时间里，杰克只得使尽浑身解数，在保证妻女安全的同时，还得保护总统候选人派尔默的安全……
76.plotEn: Counterterrorism agent Jack Bauer fights the bad guys of the world, a day at a time. With each week's episode unfolding in real-time, "24" covers a single day in the life of Bauer each season.

77.plot: 费舍尔家在洛杉矶经营殡仪馆。每一集以一次死亡开场，活着的人则继续吵架、相爱和把遗体推进房间。
77.plotEn: The Fisher family runs a funeral home in Los Angeles. Each episode opens with a death. The living go on arguing, loving, and wheeling the body into the room.
77.playbill: 一家人经营殡仪馆，每集开头都会死一个人，死亡成了日常话题。它真正讲的是活着的人怎样面对失去、性取向和家庭关系。最后几分钟的蒙太奇，被公认为电视剧史上最好的结局之一。
77.playbillEn: A family runs a funeral home. Someone dies at the start of each episode, and death becomes an ordinary subject. What it is really about is how the living face loss, sexuality, and the family. The montage in the last few minutes is widely taken as one of the best endings in the history of television.

78.plot:
大唐皇后武则天（归亚蕾 饰）怀胎12月而无法临盆。大雨连天，当大胜突厥的喜讯传来之时，武则天羊水破了。公主就这样在漫天风雨中来到世界。唐高宗李治认定女儿的降世将为天下带来好运，当场赐名太平公主。

　　少年太平（周迅 饰）顽皮不堪，捉弄三个哥哥，戳破好姐妹韦氏（胡静 饰）与哥哥显的小爱情，却也目睹了宫内斗争的风雨。但这些风雨离太平还很遥远。直到她16岁与韦氏偷偷出宫，在夜市扰攘中偶遇薛绍（赵文瑄 饰），少女情窦初开。

　　在太平的请愿下，武则天明知薛绍早有妻室也答应了太平的请婚，一手安排了薛绍妻子慧娘的赐死，也为太平的婚姻悲剧埋下伏笔。婚后无论太平如何温柔体贴，薛绍始终不置一词。然而倔强为爱不顾一切的太平（陈红 饰）赢得了薛家上下的信任，当真相被无情揭露时，薛家对她的唯一请求是保留薛家的血脉——叶儿。薛绍的死给太平带来了极大的创伤，也为母女关系扯开一道无法弥合的裂缝。

　　武则天登基，创立大周朝。太平为了与母亲赌气而嫁给憨厚老实却一无所长的武攸嗣（傅彪 饰），度过了五年漫长的毫无喜悦的婚姻。但这段时期却培养了太平的政治能力，她一而再再而三地为母亲解决了政治危机，深得武则天器重。然而她仍然拒绝入主政治。深爱太平却苦于无法得到太平的心的武攸嗣一次酒后偷欢，被太平撞见后羞愧自尽。太平就这样结束了自己的第二段婚姻。

　　当与薛绍长相酷似的张易之（赵文瑄 饰）出现在太平面前时，太平的心再次被捕。然而在交往中，她明白张易之绝对不是薛绍，他们只有情欲的纠缠，而张易之是渴望通过掌控女人来掌控天下。张易之不仅与太平有染，还与韦氏和武则天有关系，这深深地伤害了太平的心。当张易之企图篡位时，远道赶来的太平一刀结束了他的生命，斩断了自己的爱情。

　　武则天去世，太平成了镇国公主。侄子李隆基对她呵护有加，当年的叶儿也长成了高大的好青年，并与李隆基是挚交好友。这两位年轻人用自己的方式爱着太平：李隆基是要让姑母得到天下权利而爱她，叶儿则是让太平离开权利纷争而爱她。这矛盾一触即发……
78.plotEn: Palace of Desire, also known as Da Ming Gong Ci, is a Chinese television series based on the life story of Princess Taiping, a daughter of China's only female emperor Wu Zetian. Directed by Li Shaohong and Zeng Nianping, the series starred Chen Hong, Zhou Xun, Gui Yalei and Winston Chao in the leading roles. It was first broadcast on CCTV-8 in mainland China on March 30, 2000.

81.plot: 故事讲述了一群白宫幕僚们的工作与爱情生活。通过起伏跌宕的剧情，揭示白宫政治内幕，以及幕僚们在权力、良知、爱情面前的选择。但是不管这些人平日里如何明争暗斗，在关键时刻，他们仍是总统的得力助手，团结的群体，是一切问题迎刃而解的英雄人物。而白宫西翼是美国总统及其幕僚工作的地方。虚构的总统杰克是来自新罕布什尔州的民主党员，他的祖先曾参与签署美国独立宣言，其身上散发出领袖魅力。从早到晚，杰克的幕僚为他在大众及传媒面前应付各种场合。麦利奥为白宫的幕僚长，同时也是杰克的心腹；他的机智和缜密思维让他对国家的动脉随时保持高度警觉。副幕僚长黎祖殊则是个长袖善舞的策略家，不过有时候又太过执己见。新闻秘书祈思静大部分时间要巧妙应付传媒各种尖锐问题。政治顾问甘文迪、总统私人助理杨查理、白宫内阁成员史森美及辛杜比等也是这个来自各种领域的精英分子班子的成员。
81.plotEn: The West Wing provides a glimpse into presidential politics in the nation's capital as it tells the stories of the members of a fictional presidential administration. These interesting characters have humor and dedication that touches the heart while the politics that they discuss touch on everyday life.

82.plot:
这部剧以幽默和讽刺的方式展现了一个工薪阶层家庭混乱、荒诞却充满温情的日常生活，深入探讨了家庭成员之间的关系和沟通问题。

其是一部非常经典的美国情景喜剧，于2000年至2006年在福克斯电视台播出。之所以称之为经典，是因为它打破了传统情景喜剧“父慈子孝”的假象。它展示了贫穷、压力、不公和疯狂，但在这个家里，即使彼此间互相折磨、互相算计，当外界来袭时，他们永远是一致对外的整体。
82.plotEn: A gifted young teen tries to survive life with his dimwitted, dysfunctional family.

88.plot: Sports Night并不是一个体育剧, 而是围绕一档体育电视节目展开. Dan Rydell 和 Casey McCall (Peter Krause) 两人共同主持列居第三的体育新闻节目"运动之夜". 身为助手的 Natalie 和数据专家 Jeremy 携手帮助"运动之夜"的出品人 Dana (Felicity Huffman). 他们的工作是报告体育界的新闻, 不论是喜讯或丑闻. 故事的起头由Casey的离婚开始. Casey把离婚的怨气发泄在同伴头上. Dana 被上司施加压力, 不得已要处理 Casey 的态度问题. Casey 因离婚而开始对自己的生活进行反思. 在名运动员因他们的社会身份得以逍遥法外的同时, Casey 因为工作而要报道这些丑闻. 对此 Casey 受够了. 或许该是和多年的伙伴道别的时候了......
88.plotEn: The offbeat cast and crew of a sports news show deal with professional, personal, and ethical challenges while functioning in a pressure-cooker work environment.

89.plot:
30岁的过气女模特叶山南（山口智子饰）在婚礼当天惨遭无良未婚夫卷款逃婚。当她怒不可遏的狂奔到未婚夫居所，只堵截到了无辜的室友濑名秀俊（木村拓哉饰）——一个不得志的24岁钢琴家。身无分文又无家可归的小南对濑名威逼利诱，成为了他的新同居人。两人在同一屋檐下的生活磕磕绊绊 ，事业爱情也都不甚顺畅，渐渐竟生惺惺相惜之感。小南的弟弟叶山真二（竹野内丰饰）带着女友突然造访，与濑名暗恋的学妹奥泽凉子（松隆子饰）暗生情愫，使得众人关系更为微妙。濑名在小南与凉子间徘徊，令追求小南的摄影师杉崎得以强势介入，两人的感情面临岌岌可危的局面……在这个神赐的悠长假期里，他们是否都能听从内心真实的选择，找到最适合的归宿？

本剧曾一举包揽第九回日剧学院赏最优秀作品赏、主演男/女优赏、助演男/女优赏、脚本赏等10项大奖。
89.plotEn: Minami who is dumped by her ex-boyfriend, Asakura, on their wedding day. She later meets Sena, Asakura's ex-roommate and a pianist, and lives with him as she has no other place to stay. What will happen to her during this long vacation?

95.plot: 剧情围绕巴尔的摩警察局的一群凶杀案调查小组的侦探人员展开，深入描述了警察局探员细致入微、抽丝剥茧的探案过程。与其他同类电视剧不同的是，该剧非常强调真实性，几乎所有的细节都建立在实际探案的基础上。
95.plotEn: An American police procedural chronicling the work of a fictional version of the Baltimore Police Department's Homicide Unit.

97.plot: 这是美国历史上最伟大的喜剧之一。这一切都来自一位名叫弗莱泽的波士顿的精神病医生，在结束了自己两段不幸福的婚姻后，心灰薏冷的返回了自己父亲的老家西雅图，父亲从英国请来的私人女健康顾问以及同为精神病医生的弟弟共同住进了一所公寓，弗莱泽医生在当地的广播电台找到了工作，充当一个类似心理咨询栏目的主播，在这个岗位上，他可以借着电波为人们解决心理上的难题，也因此结识了很多朋友，也被迫天天面对着“热情”的女节目制作人。同时，作为喜剧，弗莱泽的后院也不会安然无恙。他的警察父亲倒不是最麻烦的，麻烦的是他弟弟深深暗恋着女健康顾问，经过弗莱泽和弟弟六年的努力，二人终于开始交往，种种复杂的情况带来了无穷的笑料。
97.plotEn: After many years spent at the “Cheers” bar, Frasier moves back home to Seattle to work as a radio psychiatrist after his policeman father gets shot in the hip on duty.

98.plot: 这是发生在美国芝加哥一家急诊室的故事，这里每天收治的都是需要急救的病人，每位医护人员都用自己的高超的医术和仁慈的爱心对每一位患者进行救助，每天有很多人从这里健康地走出，也有很多生命在这里画上句号，但是弥漫在急诊室里的温暖感受人的空气，却一直没有变过……健康与病痛相连，生命与死亡并存，这部剧集讲述发生在急诊室里真实而又感人的故事。
98.plotEn: ER explores the inner workings of an urban teaching hospital and the critical issues faced by the dedicated physicians and staff of its overburdened emergency room.

99.plot: 古畑任三郎是一名警视厅搜查科刑警。他是个不打领带、从不带枪、甚至看见枪就全身发抖的刑警，不过却可以侦破各种奇怪的的案件，他的两句名言就是：“世上没有真正的完美犯罪”、“要想在我面前犯案，就像在魔术师面前变魔术一样”。
99.plotEn:
Furuhata Ninzaburō is a Japanese television series that ran periodically on Fuji Television from 1994 until its final episodes in 2006. It was written by Japanese playwright Kōki Mitani and is often referred to as the Japanese version of Columbo.

The series is a police detective drama starring actor Masakazu Tamura as Furuhata Ninzaburo and Masahiko Nishimura as his stereotypically bumbling sidekick, Shintaro Imaizumi. The program aired weekly and featured a guest villain each time, usually a famous talent in Japan. Pop-stars like SMAP, television hosts like Sanma Akashiya and even sports figures like Ichiro Suzuki have been featured on this program. It was one of the most popular television dramas in the history of Japanese television, having spawned several seasons and TV specials.

101.plot:
《大卫·莱特曼深夜秀》（Late Show with David Letterman）是美国CBS电视台的一档夜间脱口秀节目，由大卫·莱特曼主持。该节目于1993年8月30日首次播出，由莱特曼的制作公司Worldwide Pants Incorporated和CBS电视制作工作室联合制作。节目中的音乐总监及现场乐队——CBS交响乐团的领队是保罗·沙佛。首席编剧为马特·罗伯茨，播音员为艾伦·卡尔特。在美国各大主流深夜节目中，《大卫·莱特曼深夜秀》在累积平均观众数方面排名第二，播出集数方面位列第三。2009年，该节目的广告收入高达2.71亿美元，在同类节目中居首。

在美国大多数市场，《大卫·莱特曼深夜秀》通常于东部/太平洋时间晚上11点35分播出，但录制时间为周一至周三下午4点30分，周四则分别在下午3点30分和6点进行两次录制。通常情况下，周四录的第二期节目会在当周周五播出。

2002年，《大卫·莱特曼深夜秀》被《电视指南》（TV Guide）评为“有史以来最伟大的50个电视节目”中的第七名。根据与Worldwide Pants签订的合同，CBS已将该节目的播出合约延续至2014年；届时，大卫·莱特曼将超越约翰尼·卡森，成为任职时间最长的深夜脱口秀主持人。
101.plotEn: David Letterman uses mature humor to appeal to his audience in this weeknight series, which gets its music from a house band led by Paul Shaffer. Among the show's most-famous segments are the Top Ten List and Stupid Pet Tricks, the latter of which subsequently led to an additional recurring segment called Stupid Human Tricks.

102.plot: 本系列是美国制作的一部犯罪题材的电视剧，主要讲述了曼哈顿第15分局警探的破案经历。本剧在讲述真实的犯罪和警方侦破细节的同时，也深入刻画了警察的平凡生活，描述了办案期间的矛盾心态及警察的生活烦恼。
102.plotEn: Police drama set in New York City, exploring the internal and external struggles of the fictional 15th precinct of Manhattan. Each episode typically intertwined several plots involving an ensemble cast.

105.plot:
《我会飞走》是一部美剧电视连续剧，以 20 世纪 50 年代末和 1960 年代初为背景，发生在美国南部一个未指定的州。该剧于 1991 年至 1993 年在 NBC 播出，由雷吉娜·泰勒 (Regina Taylor) 饰演莉莉·哈珀 (Lilly Harper)，她是地区检察官福雷斯特·贝德福德 (Forrest Bedford) 家族的黑人管家，其名字讽刺地引用了三K党创始人内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特 (Nathan Bedford Forrest)。随着节目的进展，莉莉越来越多地参与民权运动，最终事件也牵涉到福雷斯特。

《我会飞走》赢得了 1992 年两项艾美奖，并总共获得 23 项提名。它获得了三项人道奖、两项金球奖、两项全国有色人种协进会形象奖杰出剧集奖和一项皮博迪奖。然而，该剧从未成为收视率大片，尽管遭到评论家和观众组织的广泛抗议，但 NBC 仍于 1993 年取消了该剧。

该节目取消后，制作了一部时长两小时的电影《我要飞走了：过去和现在》，以解决第二季中悬而未决的故事情节，并为该剧提供一个真正的结局。这部电影于 1993 年 10 月 11 日在 PBS 上播出。它的主要故事情节与 1955 年埃米特·蒂尔被谋杀的真实故事非常相似。
105.plotEn:
I'll Fly Away is an American drama television series set during the late 1950s and early 1960s, in an unspecified Southern U.S. state. It aired on NBC from 1991 to 1993 and starred Regina Taylor as Lilly Harper, a black housekeeper for the family of district attorney Forrest Bedford, whose name is an ironic reference to Nathan Bedford Forrest, the founder of the Ku Klux Klan. As the show progressed, Lilly became increasingly involved in the Civil Rights Movement, with events eventually drawing in Forrest as well.

I'll Fly Away won two 1992 Emmy Awards, and 23 nominations in total. It won three Humanitas Prizes, two Golden Globe Awards, two NAACP Image Awards for Outstanding Drama Series, and a Peabody Award. However, the series was never a ratings blockbuster, and it was canceled by NBC in 1993, despite widespread protests by critics and viewer organizations.

After the program's cancellation, a two-hour movie, I'll Fly Away: Then and Now, was produced, in order to resolve dangling storylines from Season 2, and provide the series with a true finale. The movie aired on October 11, 1993 on PBS. Its major storyline closely paralleled the true story of the 1955 murder of Emmett Till in Money, Mississippi. Thereafter, PBS began airing repeats of the original episodes, ceasing after one complete showing of the entire series.

106.plot: 没有主题，没有主线，却造就了一部里程碑般的情景喜剧。喜剧演员杰里和他的三位尖刻而幽默的朋友就这样在无聊与荒谬里不断发现乐趣。
106.plotEn: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.

107.plot: 一位刚从哥伦比亚大学医学院毕业的学生，在获得州政府提供的奖学金后，被要求前往阿拉斯加一个民风奇特的小镇开设诊所。
107.plotEn: After receiving a scholarship from the state, a recent Columbia University medical school graduate is required to set up his practice in an eccentric Alaskan town.

110.plot:
19世纪工业革命传到美国，美国经济迅速发展，同时美国获得了西部的大片领土，急需劳动力，南方奴隶制成为经济发展的障碍。 1860年主张废除奴隶制的林肯当选总统，南方奴隶主发动叛乱，南方蓄奴州纷纷独立，1861年2月组成邦联政府，戴维斯当选总统。同年4月南方邦联军先发制人攻占萨姆特要塞，内战爆发。

　　南军准备充分，势如破竹，很快占领了海军基地诺福克，5月6日占领铁路枢纽马纳萨斯，进逼华盛顿，北军仓促应战，24日进入福吉尼亚。7月21日，北军被击溃，逃回华盛顿，林肯紧急动员50万志愿军。1862年，北军发动进攻，西线由格兰特指挥，进展顺利，2月攻克亨利堡和多纳尔森堡，4月在夏洛战役中击败南军，5月攻克科林斯和孟菲斯，解放了肯塔基和田那西。东线北军则进展迟缓，7月被罗伯特.李指挥的南军击溃，李乘胜北进，8月在布尔河再次击败北军，兵临华盛顿，9月两军进行安提塔姆会战，李被击退。12月北军在弗雷德里斯克堡战役中再次被李击败。

　　1863 年元旦林肯颁布「解放宣言」宣布解放黑奴，允许黑人参加北方军队，之后又颁布「宅地法」，允许所有美国人得到西部的土地。同年5月，北军再次进攻里士满，在切斯罗维尔被李击退。6月李再次北进，7月1日两军在葛底斯堡展开决战，3日南军被击败。在李北进的同时，格兰特在西线包围了南军防守密西西比河的要塞维克斯堡，5月22日北军发动总攻，进行了长达47天的炮击，7月4日南军投降。7月8日北军占领哈得逊港，南军被分割成东西两部分。9月北军攻克查塔努加，11月击退南军的反击。

　　1864年北方发动全面进攻，5～6月格兰特率军同李进行一系列会战，李虽然每次都能取胜，但北军的援军不断到达，李军团陷于绝望。6月15日，北军进攻彼得斯堡，双方相持不下，拖住了南军主力达9个月。7月厄尔利率南军一部再次奔袭华盛顿，被北军谢里登部击退，谢里登在进军途中实施焦土战略，厄尔利军瓦解。5月谢尔曼在西线发起进攻，9月2日攻占亚特兰大，并破坏了该城。之后谢尔曼以宽正面向佐治亚海岸进军，沿途实施焦土战略破坏了一切南方可资利用的资源，12月21日谢尔曼攻占萨凡纳，将南方邦联东部分割成南北两半。1865年1月，谢尔曼北上，2月相继攻克哥伦比亚和查尔斯顿，3月和格兰特会师，4月3日攻占彼得斯堡，9日李率残部投降。4月14日，南方派人刺杀了林肯。26日南方投降，内战结束。

　　南北战争摧毁了奴隶制，为美国资本主义经济的发展扫清了道路。这次战争中工业革命带来了军事上的巨大进步，双方使用了金属弹壳和后装填步枪作战，使用铁路和蒸汽船实现快速的兵力机动和集结，使用蒸汽铁甲战舰进行海战，机械连发枪第一次投入实战，特别是北方发展了制造标准化零件组装武器的生产方式，大大提高了工业生产效率。
110.plotEn: A documentary on the American Civil War narrated by Ken Burns, covering the secession of the Confederacy to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln.

111.plot: 《三十多岁》是一部关于一群三十多岁的婴儿潮一代的美国电视剧。
111.plotEn: thirtysomething is an American television drama about a group of baby boomers in their late thirties.

112.plot: 墨菲·布朗 (Murphy Brown) 是一位正在康复中的酒鬼，在贝蒂·福特诊所 (Betty Ford Clinic) 住院治疗中心住过一段时间后，他首次重返虚构的新闻杂志《仅供参考》。 Over 40 and single, she is sharp tongued and hard as nails. In her profession, she is considered one of the boys, having shattered many glass ceilings encountered during her career.她在《仅供参考》新闻杂志上占据主导地位，被描绘成美国最有影响力的媒体人物之一（尽管不是最热情或更富有同情心的）。
112.plotEn: Murphy Brown is a recovering alcoholic who returns to the fictional newsmagazine FYI for the first time following a stay at the Betty Ford Clinic residential treatment center. Over 40 and single, she is sharp tongued and hard as nails. In her profession, she is considered one of the boys, having shattered many glass ceilings encountered during her career. Dominating the FYI news magazine, she is portrayed as one of America's hardest-hitting (though not the warmest or more sympathetic) media personalities.

113.plot: 抗战初期，外国留学生方鸿渐（陈道明饰）回到了祖国。方鸿渐其实是在国外混了几年，一个学位没取得，最后没法才买了个学位归国的。出身封建家庭的鸿渐家里早给他订了亲，只是未婚妻没来得及和他结婚就逝世了。鸿渐回国后一直居住在丈人的家里，丈人颇有些能耐，为他谋了一份不错的职业。女博士苏文纨一直对鸿渐有好感，而鸿渐迷恋的却是在苏小姐家里第一次拜访认识的唐小姐。随后，鸿渐与唐小姐渐渐打得火热，然而丈人家看出了他和唐小姐的往来，渐渐冷落了他，而后鸿渐和唐小姐亦因误会而结束。 失恋后的鸿渐和当时同样追求苏小姐失败的留学生赵辛楣（英达饰）成了莫逆，二人同时受到了内地的三闾大学的聘请。于是两位好友一起上路了，前往三闾大学去开展他们的新生活。
113.plotEn: Set in the 1930s, “Fortress Besieged” follows the misadventures of Fang Hung-chien, a bumbling everyman who wastes his time studying abroad, and secures a fake degree when learning he has run out of money and must return home to China. Fang was the son of a country gentleman. A marriage had been arranged for him while at university, but the intended wife died before he could see her.

115.plot: 辛普森一家是来自美国普通的五口之家，荷马是春田镇核能工厂的安全检查员，母亲马芝曾经是一个很有思想的女性，自从嫁给荷马后渐渐地适应了主妇生活的定式。巴特是家中的长子，天性顽皮的巴特经常爱玩一些恶作剧，以至于经常惹麻烦。妹妹丽莎是一个很聪明的孩子，同时还是素食主义者，佛教徒，爵士乐。小女马姬是一个永远长不大的孩子。故事设定于虚构小镇春田镇，从许多角度对美国的文化与社会、人的条件和电视本身进行了幽默的嘲讽，经久不衰。
115.plotEn: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

120.plot: 本剧讲述了位于波士顿南部的Eligius大街医院职员们的工作与生活。虽然只是个老教学医院，但这里却有你能遇到的最负责人最有同情心的医生和护士。在Donald Westphall 医生的带领下，Eligius大街成为了失败者和受压迫者的避难所。
120.plotEn: St. Elsewhere is an American medical drama television series that originally ran on NBC from October 26, 1982 to May 25, 1988. The series starred Ed Flanders, Norman Lloyd and William Daniels as teaching doctors at a lightly-regarded Boston hospital who gave interns a promising future in making critical medical and life decisions.

121.plot:
Frank's Place 是一部美国喜剧连续剧，于 1987-1988 电视季在哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 播出，共 22 集。该剧由休·威尔逊创作，威尔逊和剧集明星蒂姆·里德担任执行制片人。

《弗兰克的地方》是最近一部仅播出一季并获得黄金时段艾美奖杰出喜剧系列提名的节目。

《电视指南》在 2013 年“过早取消”的 60 部节目列表中将其排名第 3。
121.plotEn:
Frank's Place is an American comedy-drama series which aired on CBS for 22 episodes during the 1987-1988 television season. The series was created by Hugh Wilson and executive produced by Wilson and series star Tim Reid.

Frank's Place is the most recent show that ran for only one season which was nominated for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Comedy Series.

TV Guide ranked it #3 on their 2013 list of 60 shows that were "Cancelled Too Soon".

122.plot: 两位好朋友，一位傻傻的只会学习，另一位学渣喜欢学霸但是不敢表白…
122.plotEn: Trong Nghia and Nhat Minh have been close friends since childhood, but suddenly one day Trong Nghia realized that he had different feelings for his best friend. Will Trong Nghia reveal this feeling or decide to keep silent to protect the long-standing friendship? -- Prequel of "You are my Sunshine" and "You are my stupid boy".

123.plot: 从普通男女的角度来看，民权时代的权威故事，他们的非凡行动发起了一场改变美国生活结构的运动，并体现了一场至今仍能感受到其影响的斗争。
123.plotEn: The definitive story of the Civil Rights era from the point of view of the ordinary men and women whose extraordinary actions launched a movement that changed the fabric of American life, and embodied a struggle whose reverberation continue to be felt today.

124.plot: 讲诉洛杉矶一家大型律师事务所员工的生活和工作。
124.plotEn: The high-powered law firm of McKenzie, Brackman, Chaney and Kuzak handles both criminal and civil cases, usually for high fees. However, office politics and romance often distract the legal staffers from matters in the courtroom.

125.plot: 加里·山德林饰演他自己，一个神经质、讽刺的单口喜剧演员，他碰巧意识到自己是一个情景喜剧角色。加里花在与演播室观众互动的时间和与普通演员互动的时间一样多，表演独白和节目结束时对剧集事件的总结。然而，每个人都知道他们在电视上，而不仅仅是加里；观众（本身就是一个角色）经常参与故事情节。
125.plotEn: Garry Shandling stars as himself, a neurotic, sardonic stand-up comedian who just happens to be aware he is a sitcom character. Garry spends just as much time interacting with the studio audience as he does the regular cast members, performing monologues and show-closing summations of the episode's events. However, everyone knows they're on TV, not just Garry; and the audience (itself a character) is often involved in the storyline.

129.plot: 《科斯比秀》是一部由比尔·科斯比主演的美国电视情景喜剧，从 1984 年 9 月 20 日到 1992 年 4 月 30 日在 NBC 播出了八季。该剧主要讲述了居住在纽约布鲁克林的中上阶层非裔美国家庭赫克斯塔布尔 (Huxtable) 家族的故事。
129.plotEn: The Cosby Show is an American television situation comedy starring Bill Cosby, which aired for eight seasons on NBC from September 20, 1984 until April 30, 1992. The show focuses on the Huxtable family, an upper middle-class African-American family living in Brooklyn, New York.

130.plot: 在第二次世界大战中英国统治的最后几年，印度因强奸而被不公正逮捕，引发了在战争和个人阴谋背景下探讨身份和个人责任的问题。
130.plotEn: In India, during the final years of British rule in World War II, an unjust arrest for rape sets off questions of identity and personal responsibility being explored against a background of war and personal intrigue.
